overall_notes: This paper focuses on analyzing attention mechanisms in Transformers (BERT and NMT systems) rather than evaluating NLG outputs per se. The NLG component is primarily through the German-to-English machine translation system where word alignments are extracted and evaluated using AER. The paper's main contribution is methodological (norm-based analysis) rather than NLG output evaluation.
